registry_disposition.reason: This change establishes the repository-owned static security gate for the .mjs material, because the external deep scanner's language packs do not register the .mjs extension and its analysed set for this repository contains none of it (measured 2026-10-21). The new scripts/tools/scan-source-security.mjs enumerates, reads and parses every .mjs and .js file under the governed roots (runtime, scripts, providers, tests), applies four deterministic rules each naming a concrete defect class (dynamic code execution, shell interpolation through exec/execSync, unpinned network egress, non-literal dynamic import), treats an unreadable or unparseable file as a failure rather than a skip, pins the material whose absence made the external scan vacuous as REQUIRED COVERAGE whose absence fails the gate, and manages disclosures through a baseline whose stale entries fail the gate so it cannot become an amnesty list. The gate is wired into the hosted workflow's step list as npm run scan:source-security. The change adds a tool and its test suite, one npm script, one CI step and one baseline file; it adds no npm dependency and changes no contract, no corpus, no record format, no digest, no ownership, no lifecycle state, no authority and no existing behavior of any other surface. The registration of the change is the new run change registration in the Registry (MAWS_SOURCE_SECURITY_SCAN_2026_10_21_001); the Atlas representation trails it.
